description: Found by card #17 on 2026-10-14 while checking whether CI runs. PR Checks run 38453036791 on main 8bd2a8ac fails its 'Dependency vulnerability gate (blocking)' step with three errors: pip-audit ignore for PYSEC-2026-3481, -3482 and -3483 EXPIRED on 2026-09-30. The ignores are .pip-audit-ignore:19-21, for mcp 1.23.3 pinned transitively by semgrep 1.172.0 (dev-only SAST tooling). The job is not a required status check on main (required: Secrets Scan, Lint, Run Tests, Playwright E2E Tests), so it blocks nothing and every main push shows PR Checks red. The last three main runs all fail it. Next: check whether a semgrep release now allows mcp>=1.28.1; upgrade if so, otherwise renew the three ignores with a new expiry and justification.
